candidates.title: Schedule focus sessions and breaks

demandEvidence.chore: Schedule timed work sessions and breaks with a Pomodoro timer.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: It has a built in pomodoro timer to schedule work sessions and breaks.

ease.reason: A basic timer can be mocked with ordinary tools, but the source describes an existing feature rather than a missing service.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: an independent productivity coach might pay for custom setup, but this Show HN description gives no unmet need or payment evidence.

feasibility.reason: A four-week timer mock is small; adapting it into a useful AI service is unsupported by this brief description.

autonomy.reason: A timer could repeat sessions automatically, but no AI task is established and a person sets the schedule.

evidence.reason: The excerpt names work sessions and breaks, but describes a feature, not a recurring unmet chore or corroborated demand.

candidates.reason: The excerpt describes an existing Pomodoro feature that schedules sessions and breaks; it does not establish an unmet need for an AI service or a buyer.

candidates.title: Guidance for a rejected workflow template

demandEvidence.chore: Get guidance to revise a workflow template after repeated submission rejection.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’m looking for some guidance regarding a workflow template submission that has been rejected three times.

ease.reason: A student could organize supplied feedback into a checklist, but the post provides no criteria or implementation reference.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: automation consultants might pay for submission help; this request establishes neither a buyer nor payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can compare a sample template with operator-supplied rules, but the actual rejection criteria are absent.

autonomy.reason: A tool could organize provided text, while an author must interpret rules and make every template change.

evidence.reason: The request states three rejections and asks for guidance, but gives no reasons, template details, recurrence beyond this case, or implementation support.

candidates.reason: A narrow feedback-to-checklist experiment is possible, but the post gives none of the rejection criteria or template details needed to produce useful guidance; provisional assessment does not qualify.
